genius.notes: Historical evidence as of the 2026-06-18 review: Circle had received conditional OCC approval in December 2025 for First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A.; the review found no token-specific public GENIUS PPSI approval. Reserve-report date recorded in that review was 2026-04-30 with unspecified date semantics. Update checked 2026-10-01: Circle announced final OCC charter approval on July 10, 2026, and the OCC lists First National Digital Currency Bank, National Association, charter 25361, among trust banks active as of August 31, 2026. Circle National Trust is an affiliate custody institution; Circle's current licensing page still names regulated affiliates as USDC issuers and describes reserve management by the trust bank as a future capability. This charter does not establish GENIUS PPSI approval, so authorizationStatus and issuerEntity are unchanged. The negative-evidence review below records a scoped October 1 search; it does not assert worldwide absence of approvals or applications.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: Within these issuer and OCC sources checked on October 1, 2026, no USDC/Circle Internet Financial, LLC GENIUS PPSI approval was located. The active First National Digital Currency Bank affiliate is identified as a trust/custody institution; its charter does not establish PPSI authorization. This finite review does not establish that no issuer anywhere has an approval or application.
